heading: Consultation with Standards Board and Board of Advisors
lead: The Commission shall carry out its duties under this part in consultation with the Standards Board and the Board of Advisors.

notes.heading: Codification
notes.text: Section was formerly classified to section 15387 of Title 42, The Public Health and Welfare, prior to editorial reclassification and renumbering as this section.
